userStories.title: News feed dashboard page
userStories.description: Create news-feed.html page that displays the daily news markdown files from news/ directory
acceptanceCriteria: Loads and renders the latest news/YYYY-MM-DD.md file
Shows date picker or links to previous days
Styled consistently with other dashboard pages
userStories.notes: News files already exist in news/ directory as markdown

userStories.title: Dashboard status overview page
userStories.description: Create a status.html page showing system health: cron jobs, Ralph status, model status, disk usage
acceptanceCriteria: Shows cron job list (reads from status API or static)
userStories.notes: Ralph writes status.json, Ollama at localhost:11434

userStories.title: Training data dashboard page
userStories.description: Create training-data.html showing knowledge pipeline stats: repos indexed, transcripts mined, training pairs generated
acceptanceCriteria: Shows count of training pairs from knowledge/training/
Shows count of transcripts from knowledge/transcripts/
Shows count of repos from knowledge/repos/
